title: Chelsea in talks to sign Atalanta defender Ahanor
summary: Chelsea are pursuing 18-year-old Italian defender Honest Ahanor from Atalanta in a reported £34.3m deal. The young defender has attracted interest from the Premier League club. This represents a significant investment in youth talent for the London side.
content: Chelsea are in talks to sign 18-year-old Atalanta and Italy defender Honest Ahanor for £34.3m.

zh.title: 切尔西正在谈判签约亚特兰大后卫阿哈诺尔
zh.summary: 切尔西正在追求来自亚特兰大的18岁意大利后卫霍内斯特·阿哈诺尔，据报道交易价格为3430万英镑。这位年轻后卫吸引了这家英超俱乐部的关注。这代表了伦敦俱乐部对青年人才的重大投资。

title: Why Herrera is playing for free in Spanish third division
summary: Ander Herrera, who has played for major European clubs, has returned to Spain to play without pay in the third tier. The midfielder has chosen to play at a lower level in his home country. This marks a significant shift in his career trajectory after playing at elite clubs.
content: Ander Herrera has represented some of the world's biggest clubs, but now he is back home playing for free in Spain's third tier - and this is why.

zh.title: 为什么赫雷拉在西班牙第三级别联赛中无偿效力
zh.summary: 曾效力于欧洲大俱乐部的安德尔·赫雷拉回到西班牙在第三级别联赛中无偿效力。这位中场球员选择在他的祖国以较低级别进行比赛。这标志着在效力于精英俱乐部后职业生涯轨迹的重大转变。

title: Glory for Hearts - will Rangers, Motherwell or Hibs qualify too?
summary: Following Hearts' achievement, attention turns to whether Rangers, Motherwell, and Hibernian will also secure European football qualification. Multiple Scottish clubs are competing for limited continental spots. The results will shape Scotland's representation in European competitions.
content: Will any of Rangers, Motherwell, or Hibs reach the Conference League?

zh.title: 心脏队的荣耀——流浪者队、莫瑟韦尔队和希布恩队也会获得资格吗？
zh.summary: 在心脏队取得成就后，人们的关注转向流浪者队、莫瑟韦尔队和希布恩队是否也会获得欧洲足球资格。多支苏格兰俱乐部正在争夺有限的洲际席位。这些结果将塑造苏格兰在欧洲竞赛中的代表。

title: Rangers agree deal for Venezuela striker Kelsy - gossip
summary: Rangers have agreed to a fee for Venezuelan striker Kelsy, one of their priority transfer targets. Celtic face competition in their pursuit of a Torino midfielder. The Scottish club is active in the transfer market ahead of the new season.
content: Rangers agree a fee for key striker target, while Celtic face competition for Torino midfielder.

zh.title: 流言蜚语：流浪者队同意与委内瑞拉前锋凯尔西进行交易
zh.summary: 流浪者队已同意为委内瑞拉前锋凯尔西支付费用，他是他们的优先引援目标之一。凯尔特人在追逐都灵中场球员时面临竞争。这家苏格兰俱乐部在新赛季前在转会市场上很活跃。

title: Uefa to push to remove Infantino after dropping boycott
summary: UEFA has abandoned its plans to boycott FIFA tournaments but will continue efforts to remove FIFA President Gianni Infantino. The confederation will pursue removal through other channels despite halting the boycott. This reflects ongoing tensions between UEFA and FIFA leadership.
content: Uefa dropped their plans to boycott Fifa tournaments on Wednesday, but will still move forward with efforts to remove Gianni Infantino.

zh.title: 欧足联放弃抵制后推动罢免因凡蒂诺
zh.summary: 欧足联已放弃抵制国际足联比赛的计划，但将继续努力罢免国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺。尽管停止了抵制，但该联合会将通过其他渠道追求罢免。这反映了欧足联和国际足联领导层之间持续的紧张关系。

title: Is Saka getting back to his best at Arsenal?
summary: Bukayo Saka has struggled with consistency in recent months but shows signs of returning to peak form this season. The Arsenal winger's performance improvements could be crucial for the club's campaign. Questions remain about his ability to maintain top-level performances throughout the season.
content: Bukayo Saka has struggled to produce his best on a consistent basis in recent months, but could be getting back to top form this season.

zh.title: 萨卡是否正在重回阿森纳的最佳状态？
zh.summary: 布卡约·萨卡在最近几个月内表现不稳定，但本赛季显示出回归巅峰状态的迹象。这位阿森纳边锋的表现进步对俱乐部的赛季目标至关重要。关于他是否能够在整个赛季中保持顶级水准仍存在疑问。
